response.rationale: Both answers are valid common terms for a marked pedestrian crossing in their respective varieties. Indonesian “zebra cross” is specifically the striped crossing, while Malaysian “lintasan pejalan kaki” is the standard generic term. The sense and relation are acceptable; no false-friend contrast is present.
